shloka_text: अपृच्छत तदा रामो दक्षिणाशाश्रमं मुनिम् । प्राञ्जलिर्विनयोपेत इदमाह वचो ऽर्थवत् ।। 7.35.1 ।।
transliteration: apṛcchata tadā rāmo dakṣiṇāśāśramaṃ munim | prāñjalirvinayopeta idamāha vaco 'rthavat || 7.35.1 ||
translation: अपृच्छत asked, तदा then, रामः Rama, दक्षिणाशा southern direction, आश्रमम् hermitage, मुनिम् the sage, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, विनय humility, उपेतः endowed with, इदम् this, आह said, वचः words, अर्थवत् meaningful,
explanation: Then Rama, with folded hands and full of humility, asked the sage (Agastya) in the hermitage of the southern direction, speaking these meaningful words.
comments: Rama extols Hanuman as surpassing even Vali and Ravana, and asks why one so mighty did not act sooner -- Agastya explains he was cursed by sages to forget his own strength, and tells of his infancy: born of Anjana and Vayu, the child leaps at the rising sun for fruit, and when Indra strikes him with the thunderbolt and breaks his jaw, the enraged Vayu withdraws the breath of life from all beings, who in their suffering appeal to Brahma.

shloka_text: अतुलं बलमेतद्वै वालिनो रावणस्य च । न त्वेताभ्यां हनुमता समं त्विति मतिर्मम ।। 7.35.2 ।।
transliteration: atulaṃ balametadvai vālino rāvaṇasya ca | na tvetābhyāṃ hanumatā samaṃ tviti matirmama || 7.35.2 ||
translation: अतुलं incomparable, बलम् strength, एतत् this, वै indeed, वालिनः of Vali, रावणस्य of Ravana, च and, न not, तु but, एताभ्याम् with these two, हनुमता with Hanuman, समम् equal, तु indeed, इति thus, मतिः opinion, मम my.
explanation: This strength of Vali and Ravana is indeed incomparable, but in my opinion, it is not equal to Hanuman's.

shloka_text: शौर्यं दाक्ष्यं बलं धैर्यं प्राज्ञता नयसाधनम् । विक्रमश्च प्रभावश्च हनूमति कृतालयाः ।। 7.35.3 ।।
transliteration: śauryaṃ dākṣyaṃ balaṃ dhairyaṃ prājñatā nayasādhanam | vikramaśca prabhāvaśca hanūmati kṛtālayāḥ || 7.35.3 ||
translation: शौर्यम् valor, दाक्ष्यम् skill, बलम् strength, धैर्यम् courage, प्राज्ञता wisdom, नयसाधनम् diplomatic skill, विक्रमः prowess, च and, प्रभावः influence, च and, हनूमति in Hanuman, कृतालयाः have made their abode.
explanation: Valor, skill, strength, courage, wisdom, diplomatic ability, prowess, and influence—all these qualities reside in Hanuman.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वैव सागरं वीक्ष्य सीदन्तीं कपिवाहिनीम् । समाश्वास्य महाबाहुर्योजनानां शतं प्लुतः ।। 7.35.4 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaiva sāgaraṃ vīkṣya sīdantīṃ kapivāhinīm | samāśvāsya mahābāhuryojanānāṃ śataṃ plutaḥ || 7.35.4 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, एव indeed, सागरम् the ocean, वीक्ष्य observing, सीदन्तीम् despairing, कपिवाहिनीम् the army of monkeys, समाश्वास्य having comforted, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतम् a hundred, प्लुतः jumped.
explanation: Having observed the ocean and seeing the monkey army despairing, the mighty-armed Hanuman comforted them and then leaped a hundred yojanas across the sea.

shloka_text: धर्षयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां रावणान्तःपुरं तदा । दृष्ट्वा सम्भाषिता चापि सीता ह्याश्वासिता तथा ।। 7.35.5 ।।
transliteration: dharṣayitvā purīṃ laṅkāṃ rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṃ tadā | dṛṣṭvā sambhāṣitā cāpi sītā hyāśvāsitā tathā || 7.35.5 ||
translation: धर्षयित्वा having harassed, पुरीम् the city, लङ्काम् Lanka, रावणान्तःपुरम् Ravana's inner palace, तदा then, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सम्भाषिता spoken to, च and, अपि also, सीता Sita, हि indeed, आश्वासिता comforted, तथा thus.
explanation: Then, having harassed the city of Lanka and Ravana's inner palace, he indeed saw Sita, conversed with her, and thus comforted her.

shloka_text: सेनाग्रगा मन्त्रिसुताः किङ्करा रावणात्मजः । एते हनुमता तत्र ह्येकेन वितिपातिताः ।। 7.35.6 ।।
transliteration: senāgragā mantrisutāḥ kiṅkarā rāvaṇātmajaḥ | ete hanumatā tatra hyekena vitipātitāḥ || 7.35.6 ||
translation: सेनाग्रगाः leaders of the army, मन्त्रिसुताः sons of ministers, किङ्कराः servants, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, एते these, हनुमता by Hanuman, तत्र there, हि indeed, एकेन by one, वितिपातिताः struck down.
explanation: The leaders of the army, the sons of ministers, the attendants, and Ravana's own son—all these were indeed struck down there by Hanuman alone.

shloka_text: भूयो बन्धाद्विमुक्तेन भाषयित्वा दशाननम् । लङ्का भस्मीकृता येन पावकेनेव मेदिनी ।। 7.35.7 ।।
transliteration: bhūyo bandhādvimuktena bhāṣayitvā daśānanam | laṅkā bhasmīkṛtā yena pāvakeneva medinī || 7.35.7 ||
translation: भूयो again, बन्धात् from bondage, विमुक्तेन by one who was released, भाषयित्वा having spoken, दशाननम् Daśānana (Rāvaṇa), लङ्का Lanka, भस्मीकृता was reduced to ashes, येन by whom, पावकेन by fire, इव like, मेदिनी the earth
explanation: By him, who, having been released from bondage, spoke to Daśānana, Lanka was reduced to ashes, as if the earth itself were consumed by fire.

shloka_text: न कालस्य न शक्रस्य न विष्णोर्वित्तपस्य च । कर्माणि तानि श्रूयन्ते यानि युद्धे हनूमतः ।। 7.35.8 ।।
transliteration: na kālasya na śakrasya na viṣṇorvittapasya ca | karmāṇi tāni śrūyante yāni yuddhe hanūmataḥ || 7.35.8 ||
translation: न not, कालस्य of Time (Yama), न not, शक्रस्य of Indra, न not, विष्णोः of Vishnu, वित्तपस्य of Kubera, च and, कर्माणि deeds, तानि those, श्रूयन्ते are heard, यानि which, युद्धे in battle, हनूमतः of Hanumān
explanation: Such deeds as those of Hanumān in battle are not heard of, even from Time (Yama), Indra, Vishnu, or Kubera.

shloka_text: एतस्य बाहुवीर्येण लङ्का सीता च लक्ष्मणः । प्राप्ता मया जयश्चैव राज्यं मित्राणि बान्धवाः ।। 7.35.9 ।।
transliteration: etasya bāhuvīryeṇa laṅkā sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ | prāptā mayā jayaścaiva rājyaṃ mitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ || 7.35.9 ||
translation: एतस्य of this one (Hanumān), बाहुवीर्येण by the strength of arms, लङ्का Lanka, सीता Sītā, च and, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmaṇa, प्राप्ता obtained, मया by me, जयः victory, च and, एव indeed, राज्यम् kingdom, मित्राणि friends, बान्धवाः relatives
explanation: By the valor of Hanumān, I regained Lanka, Sītā, Lakshmaṇa, victory, my kingdom, friends, and relatives.

shloka_text: हनूमान्यदि मे नः स्याद्वानराधिपतेः सखा । प्रवृत्तिमपि को वेत्तुं जानक्याः शक्तिमान्भवेत् ।। 7.35.10 ।।
transliteration: hanūmānyadi me naḥ syādvānarādhipateḥ sakhā | pravṛttimapi ko vettuṃ jānakyāḥ śaktimānbhavet || 7.35.10 ||
translation: हनूमान् Hanumān, यदि if, मे my, न not, स्यात् would be, वानराधिपतेः of the lord of monkeys (Sugrīva), सखा friend, प्रवृत्तिम् news, अपि even, कः who, वेत्तुम् to know, जानक्याः of Janakī (Sītā), शक्तिमान् capable, भवेत् would be
explanation: If Hanumān, the friend of the lord of monkeys, had not been with me, who would have been capable of even finding news of Janakī?

shloka_text: किमर्थं वाल्यनेनैव सुग्रीवप्रियकाम्यया । तदा वैरे समुत्पन्ने न दग्धो वीरुधो यथा ।। 7.35.11 ।।
transliteration: kimarthaṃ vālyanenaiva sugrīvapriyakāmyayā | tadā vaire samutpanne na dagdho vīrudho yathā || 7.35.11 ||
translation: किमर्थम् why, वालि Vāli, अनेन by this one (Hanumān), एव indeed, सुग्रीवप्रियकाम्यया by the desire to please Sugrīva, तदा then, वैरे when enmity, समुत्पन्ने had arisen, न not, दग्धः burnt, वीरुधः creepers, यथा like
explanation: Why then, when enmity had arisen, was Vāli not burnt by Hanumān, out of a desire to please Sugrīva, just like creepers are burnt?

shloka_text: नहि वेदितवान्मन्ये हनूमानात्मनो बलम् । यद्दृष्टवाञ्जीवितेष्टं क्लिश्यन्तं वानराधिपम् ।। 7.35.12 ।।
transliteration: nahi veditavānmanye hanūmānātmano balam | yaddṛṣṭavāñjīviteṣṭaṃ kliśyantaṃ vānarādhipam || 7.35.12 ||
translation: नहि not indeed, वेदितवान् knew, मन्ये I think, हनूमान् Hanuman, आत्मनः his own, बलम् strength, यत् because, दृष्टवान् he saw, जीवितेष्टम् dear as life, क्लिश्यन्तम् suffering, वानराधिपम् the king of monkeys.
explanation: I believe Hanuman did not know his own strength, because he saw Sugriva, who was dear to him as life, suffering.

shloka_text: एतन्मे भगवन्सर्वं हनूमति महामतौ । विस्तरेण यथातत्त्वं कथयामरपूजित ।। 7.35.13 ।।
transliteration: etanme bhagavansarvaṃ hanūmati mahāmatau | vistareṇa yathātattvaṃ kathayāmarapūjita || 7.35.13 ||
translation: एतत् this, मे to me, भगवन् O revered one, सर्वम् all, हनूमति regarding Hanuman, महामतौ the great-minded one, विस्तरेण in detail, यथातत्त्वम् truly, कथय please tell, अमरपूजित O one worshipped by gods.
explanation: O revered one, worshipped by gods, please tell me all about the great-minded Hanuman in detail and truly.

shloka_text: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हेतुयुक्तमृषिस्तदा । हनूमतः समक्षं तमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 7.35.14 ।।
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā hetuyuktamṛṣistadā | hanūmataḥ samakṣaṃ tamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 7.35.14 ||
translation: राघवस्य of Rama, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हेतुयुक्तम् reasonable, ऋषिः the sage, तदा then, हनूमतः of Hanuman, समक्षम् in the presence, तम् to him, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard Rama's reasonable words, the sage then spoke these words to him in Hanuman's presence.

shloka_text: सत्यमेतद्रघुश्रेष्ठ यद्ब्रवीषि हनूमतः । न बले विद्यते तुल्यो न गतौ न मतौ परः ।। 7.35.15 ।।
transliteration: satyametadraghuśreṣṭha yadbravīṣi hanūmataḥ | na bale vidyate tulyo na gatau na matau paraḥ || 7.35.15 ||
translation: सत्यम् true, एतत् this, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of Raghus, यत् what, ब्रवीषि you say, हनूमतः of Hanuman, न not, बले in strength, विद्यते exists, तुल्यः an equal, न not, गतौ in speed, न not, मतौ in intellect, परः another.
explanation: O best of Raghus, what you say about Hanuman is true: there is no one equal to him in strength, speed, or intellect.

shloka_text: अमोघशापैः शप्तस्तु दत्तो ऽस्य मुनिभिः पुरा । न वेत्ता हि बलं येन बली सन्निरिमर्दनः ।। 7.35.16 ।।
transliteration: amoghaśāpaiḥ śaptastu datto 'sya munibhiḥ purā | na vettā hi balaṃ yena balī sannirimardanaḥ || 7.35.16 ||
translation: अमोघशापैः by unfailing curses, शप्तः cursed, तु indeed, दत्तः given, अस्य to him, मुनिभिः by sages, पुरा formerly, न not, वेत्ता one who knows, हि indeed, बलम् strength, येन by which, बली strong, सन् being, अरिमर्दनः destroyer of foes.
explanation: Indeed, he was formerly cursed by sages with unfailing curses, by which, though he is strong and a destroyer of foes, he does not know his own strength.

shloka_text: बाल्ये ऽप्येतेन यत्कर्म कृतं राम महाबल । तन्न वर्णयितुं शक्यमिति बालतया ऽ ऽस्यते ।। 7.35.17 ।।
transliteration: bālye 'pyetena yatkarma kṛtaṃ rāma mahābala | tanna varṇayituṃ śakyamiti bālatayā ' 'syate || 7.35.17 ||
translation: बाल्ये in childhood, अपि even, एतेन by him, यत् what, कर्म deed, कृतं done, राम O Rama, महाबल O mighty-armed, तत् that, न not, वर्णयितुं to describe, शक्यम् possible, इति thus, बालतया due to childhood, आस्यते it remains.
explanation: O mighty Rama, it is impossible to fully describe the deeds performed by him (Hanuman) even in his childhood, as they are beyond words due to his tender age.

shloka_text: यदि वा ऽस्ति त्वभिप्रायस्तच्छ्रोतुं तव राघव । समाधाय मतिं राम निशामय वदाम्यहम् ।। 7.35.18 ।।
transliteration: yadi vā 'sti tvabhiprāyastacchrotuṃ tava rāghava | samādhāya matiṃ rāma niśāmaya vadāmyaham || 7.35.18 ||
translation: यदि if, वा or, अस्ति is, तु indeed, अभिप्रायः desire, तत् that, श्रोतुम् to hear, तव your, राघव O Raghava, समाधाय concentrating, मतिम् mind, राम O Rama, निशामय listen, वदामि I speak, अहम् I.
explanation: O Raghava, if you indeed have a desire to hear those deeds, then O Rama, concentrate your mind and listen, for I shall narrate them.

shloka_text: सूर्यदत्तवरस्वर्णः सुमेरुर्नाम पर्वतः । यत्र राज्यं प्रशास्त्यस्य केसरी नाम वै पिता ।। 7.35.19 ।।
transliteration: sūryadattavarasvarṇaḥ sumerurnāma parvataḥ | yatra rājyaṃ praśāstyasya kesarī nāma vai pitā || 7.35.19 ||
translation: सूर्यदत्तवरस्वर्णः golden due to a boon given by the Sun, सुमेरुः Sumeru, नाम named, पर्वतः mountain, यत्र where, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रशास्ति rules, अस्य his, केसरी Kesari, नाम named, वै indeed, पिता father.
explanation: There is a mountain named Sumeru, golden due to a boon granted by the Sun, where his (Hanuman's) father, named Kesari, indeed rules.

shloka_text: तस्य भार्या बभूवैषा ह्यञ्जनेति परिश्रुता । जनयामास तस्यां वै वायुरात्मजमुत्तमम् ।। 7.35.20 ।।
transliteration: tasya bhāryā babhūvaiṣā hyañjaneti pariśrutā | janayāmāsa tasyāṃ vai vāyurātmajamuttamam || 7.35.20 ||
translation: तस्य his, भार्या wife, बभूव was, एषा this, हि indeed, अञ्जना Anjana, इति thus, परिश्रुता well-known, जनयामास begot, तस्यां in her, वै indeed, वायुः Vayu, आत्मजम् son, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: His (Kesari's) well-known wife was Anjana, in whom Vayu, the Wind-god, indeed begot an excellent son.

shloka_text: शालिशूकनिभाभासं प्रासूतामुं तदा ऽञ्जना । फलान्याहर्तुकामा वै निष्क्रान्ता गहनेचरा ।। 7.35.21 ।।
transliteration: śāliśūkanibhābhāsaṃ prāsūtāmuṃ tadā 'ñjanā | phalānyāhartukāmā vai niṣkrāntā gahanecarā || 7.35.21 ||
translation: शालिशूकनिभाभासम् having a luster like a ripe paddy grain, प्रासूता gave birth, अमुम् to him, तदा then, अञ्जना Anjana, फलानि fruits, आहर्तुकामा desiring to bring, वै indeed, निष्क्रान्ता went out, गहनेचरा moving in the forest.
explanation: Anjana, who moved in the forest, then gave birth to him (Hanuman), who had a luster like a ripe paddy grain, and she had gone out desiring to gather fruits.

shloka_text: एष मातुर्वियोगाच्च क्षुधया च भृशार्दितः । रुरोद शिशुरत्यर्थं शिशुः शरवणे यथा ।। 7.35.22 ।।
transliteration: eṣa māturviyogācca kṣudhayā ca bhṛśārditaḥ | ruroda śiśuratyarthaṃ śiśuḥ śaravaṇe yathā || 7.35.22 ||
translation: एषः this (one), मातुः of mother, वियोगात् from separation, च and, क्षुधया by hunger, च and, भृशार्दितः greatly distressed, रुरोद cried, शिशुः the child, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, शिशुः a child, शरवणे in the reed-forest, यथा just as,
explanation: This child, greatly distressed by separation from his mother and by hunger, cried exceedingly, just like the child Kartikeya in the reed-forest.

shloka_text: तदोद्यन्तं विवस्वन्तं जपापुष्पोत्करोपमम् । ददर्श फललोभाच्च ह्युत्पपात रविं प्रति ।। 7.35.23 ।।
transliteration: tadodyantaṃ vivasvantaṃ japāpuṣpotkaropamam | dadarśa phalalobhācca hyutpapāta raviṃ prati || 7.35.23 ||
translation: तदा then, उद्यन्तम् rising, विवस्वन्तम् the sun, जपापुष्पोत्करोपमम् resembling a cluster of hibiscus flowers, ददर्श he saw, फललोभात् from desire for fruit, च and, हि indeed, उत्पपात he flew up, रविम् towards the sun, प्रति towards,
explanation: Then, he saw the rising sun, which resembled a cluster of hibiscus flowers, and out of a desire for fruit, he indeed flew up towards the sun.

shloka_text: बालार्काभिमुखो बालो बालार्क इव मूर्तिमान् । ग्रहीतुकामो बालार्कं प्लवते ऽम्बरमध्यगः ।। 7.35.24 ।।
transliteration: bālārkābhimukho bālo bālārka iva mūrtimān | grahītukāmo bālārkaṃ plavate 'mbaramadhyagaḥ || 7.35.24 ||
translation: बालार्काभिमुखः facing the morning sun, बालः the child, बालार्कः the morning sun, इव like, मूर्तिमान् embodied, ग्रहीतुकामः desirous of seizing, बालार्कम् the morning sun, प्लवते he soars, अम्बरमध्यगः moving through the middle of the sky,
explanation: The child, facing the morning sun, soared through the middle of the sky like an embodied morning sun, desirous of seizing the sun itself.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्प्लवमाने तु शिशुभावे हनूमति । देवदानवयक्षाणां विस्मयः सुमहानभूत् ।। 7.35.25 ।।
transliteration: etasminplavamāne tu śiśubhāve hanūmati | devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ vismayaḥ sumahānabhūt || 7.35.25 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, प्लवमाने soaring, तु indeed, शिशुभावे in the state of a child, हनूमति Hanumān, देवदानवयक्षाणाम् of gods, demons, and yakshas, विस्मयः wonder, सुमहान् very great, अभूत् arose,
explanation: Indeed, a very great wonder arose among the gods, demons, and yakshas as this child Hanumān soared through the sky.

shloka_text: नाप्येवं वेगवान्वायुर्गरुडो वा मनस्तथा । यथा ऽयं वायुपुत्रस्तु क्रमते ऽम्बरमुत्तमम् ।। 7.35.26 ।।
transliteration: nāpyevaṃ vegavānvāyurgaruḍo vā manastathā | yathā 'yaṃ vāyuputrastu kramate 'mbaramuttamam || 7.35.26 ||
translation: न not, अपि even, एवम् thus, वेगवान् swift, वायुः wind, गरुडः Garuda, वा or, मनः mind, तथा similarly, यथा as, अयम् this, वायुपुत्रः son of Vayu, तु indeed, क्रमते traverses, अम्बरम् the sky, उत्तमम् excellent,
explanation: Neither the wind, nor Garuda, nor even the mind is as swift as this son of Vayu, who indeed traverses the high sky.

shloka_text: यदि तावच्छिशोरस्य त्वीदृशो गतिविक्रमः । यौवनं बलमासाद्य कथं वेगो भविष्यति ।। 7.35.27 ।।
transliteration: yadi tāvacchiśorasya tvīdṛśo gativikramaḥ | yauvanaṃ balamāsādya kathaṃ vego bhaviṣyati || 7.35.27 ||
translation: यदि if, तावत् indeed, शिशोः of this child, अस्य of this, तु indeed, ईदृशः such, गतिविक्रमः speed and prowess, यौवनम् youth, बलम् strength, आसाद्य having attained, कथम् how, वेगः speed, भविष्यति will be
explanation: If this child, even in his infancy, possesses such speed and prowess, how much greater will his velocity become when he attains youth and full strength?

shloka_text: तमनुप्लवते वायुः प्लवन्तं पुत्रमात्मनः । सूर्यदाहभयाद्रक्षंस्तुषारचयशीतलः ।। 7.35.28 ।।
transliteration: tamanuplavate vāyuḥ plavantaṃ putramātmanaḥ | sūryadāhabhayādrakṣaṃstuṣāracayaśītalaḥ || 7.35.28 ||
translation: तम् him, अनुप्लवते follows, वायुः the wind, प्लवन्तम् flying, पुत्रम् son, आत्मनः his own, सूर्यदाहभयात् from the fear of being burnt by the sun, रक्षन् protecting, तुषारचयशीतलः cool with a mass of frost
explanation: Vayu, the wind god, followed his own son (Hanuman) as he flew, protecting him from the sun's scorching heat by making himself cool with a mass of frost.

shloka_text: बहुयोजनसाहस्रं क्रमत्येष गतोम्बरम् । पितुर्बलाच्च बाल्याच्च भास्कराभ्याशमागतः ।। 7.35.29 ।।
transliteration: bahuyojanasāhasraṃ kramatyeṣa gatombaram | piturbalācca bālyācca bhāskarābhyāśamāgataḥ || 7.35.29 ||
translation: बहुयोजनसाहस्रम् many thousands of yojanas, क्रामति traverses, एषः this one, गतः gone, अम्बरम् to the sky, पितुः of his father, बलात् by the strength, च and, बाल्यात् by his childishness, च and, भास्कर the sun, अभ्याशम् proximity, आगतः has come
explanation: This child, having traversed many thousands of yojanas into the sky, reached the vicinity of the sun, driven by his father's strength and his own childish innocence.

shloka_text: शिशुरेष त्वदोषज्ञ इति मत्वा दिवाकरः । कार्यं चात्र समायत्तमित्येवं न ददाह सः ।। 7.35.30 ।।
transliteration: śiśureṣa tvadoṣajña iti matvā divākaraḥ | kāryaṃ cātra samāyattamityevaṃ na dadāha saḥ || 7.35.30 ||
translation: शिशुः a child, एषः this, तु indeed, अदोषज्ञः innocent, इति thus, मत्वा having thought, दिवाकरः the sun, कार्यम् a purpose, च and, अत्र in this (child), समायत्तम् dependent, इति thus, एवम् in this manner, न not, ददाह burnt, सः he
explanation: Considering this child to be innocent and realizing that a significant purpose was dependent on him, the sun did not burn him.

shloka_text: यमेव दिवसं ह्येष ग्रहीतुं भास्करं प्लुतः । तमेव दिवसं राहुर्जिघृक्षति दिवाकरम् ।। 7.35.31 ।।
transliteration: yameva divasaṃ hyeṣa grahītuṃ bhāskaraṃ plutaḥ | tameva divasaṃ rāhurjighṛkṣati divākaram || 7.35.31 ||
translation: यम् which, एव indeed, दिवसम् day, हि indeed, एषः this one, ग्रहीतुम् to seize, भास्करम् the sun, प्लुतः leaped, तम् that, एव indeed, दिवसम् day, राहुः Rahu, जिघृक्षति desires to seize, दिवाकरम् the sun
explanation: On the very day that this child leaped to seize the sun, Rahu also desired to grasp the sun.

shloka_text: अनेन स परामृष्टो राम सूर्यरथोपरि । अपक्रान्तस्ततस्त्रस्तो राहुश्चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः ।। 7.35.32 ।।
transliteration: anena sa parāmṛṣṭo rāma sūryarathopari | apakrāntastatastrasto rāhuścandrārkamardanaḥ || 7.35.32 ||
translation: अनेन by him, सः he, परामृष्टः touched, राम O Rama, सूर्यरथोपरि upon the sun's chariot, अपक्रान्तः departed, ततः then, त्रस्तः frightened, राहुः Rahu, चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः the tormentor of the moon and sun.
explanation: O Rama, when he (the original Rahu), the tormentor of the moon and sun, was touched by that other one upon the sun's chariot, he became frightened and departed from there.

shloka_text: स इन्द्रभवनं गत्वा सरोषः सिंहिकासुतः । अब्रवीद्भ्रुकुटिं कृत्वा देवं देवगणैर्वृतम् ।। 7.35.33 ।।
transliteration: sa indrabhavanaṃ gatvā saroṣaḥ siṃhikāsutaḥ | abravīdbhrukuṭiṃ kṛtvā devaṃ devagaṇairvṛtam || 7.35.33 ||
translation: सः he, इन्द्रभवनम् to Indra's abode, गत्वा having gone, सरोषः enraged, सिंहिकासुतः the son of Simhika, अब्रवीत् spoke, भ्रुकुटिम् a frown, कृत्वा having made, देवम् to the god, देवगणैर्वृतम् surrounded by hosts of gods.
explanation: The enraged son of Simhika (Rahu), having gone to Indra's abode, spoke to the god (Indra) who was surrounded by hosts of gods, making a frown.

shloka_text: बुभुक्षापनयं दत्त्वा चन्द्रार्कौ मम वासव । किमिदं तत्त्वया दत्तमन्यस्य बलवृत्रहन् ।। 7.35.34 ।।
transliteration: bubhukṣāpanayaṃ dattvā candrārkau mama vāsava | kimidaṃ tattvayā dattamanyasya balavṛtrahan || 7.35.34 ||
translation: बुभुक्षापनयम् the removal of hunger, दत्त्वा having given, चन्द्रार्कौ the moon and the sun, मम to me, वासव O Vasava, किम् what, इदम् this, तत् that, त्वया by you, दत्तम् given, अन्यस्य to another, बलवृत्रहन् O slayer of Bala and Vritra.
explanation: O Vasava, O slayer of Bala and Vritra, having given the moon and sun to me as a means to satisfy my hunger, why have you now given them to another?

shloka_text: अद्याहं पर्वकाले तु जिघृक्षुः सूर्यमागतः । अथान्यो राहुरासाद्य जग्राह सहसा रविम् ।। 7.35.35 ।।
transliteration: adyāhaṃ parvakāle tu jighṛkṣuḥ sūryamāgataḥ | athānyo rāhurāsādya jagrāha sahasā ravim || 7.35.35 ||
translation: अद्य today, अहम् I, पर्वकाले at the time of conjunction, तु indeed, जिघृक्षुः desirous of seizing, सूर्यम् the sun, आगतः arrived, अथ then, अन्यः another, राहुः Rahu, आसाद्य having approached, जग्राह seized, सहसा suddenly, रविम् the sun.
explanation: Today, I had indeed arrived at the time of conjunction intending to seize the sun, but then another Rahu suddenly approached and seized the sun.

shloka_text: स राहोर्वचनं श्रुत्वा वासवः सम्भ्रमान्वितः । उत्पपातासनं हित्वा चोद्वहन्काञ्चनीं स्रजम् ।। 7.35.36 ।।
transliteration: sa rāhorvacanaṃ śrutvā vāsavaḥ sambhramānvitaḥ | utpapātāsanaṃ hitvā codvahankāñcanīṃ srajam || 7.35.36 ||
translation: सः he, राहोः of Rahu, वचनम् the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, वासवः Vasava, सम्भ्रमान्वितः filled with agitation, उत्पपात sprang up, आसनम् his seat, हित्वा having left, च and, उद्वहन् carrying, काञ्चनीम् golden, स्रजम् garland.
explanation: Having heard Rahu's words, Vasava (Indra), filled with agitation, sprang up, abandoning his seat and still wearing his golden garland.

shloka_text: ततः कैलासकूटाभं चतुर्दन्तं मदस्रवम् । शृङ्गारधारिणं प्रांशुं स्वर्णघण्टाट्टहासिनम् ।। 7.35.37 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kailāsakūṭābhaṃ caturdantaṃ madasravam | śṛṅgāradhāriṇaṃ prāṃśuṃ svarṇaghaṇṭāṭṭahāsinam || 7.35.37 ||
translation: ततः then, कैलासकूटाभं resembling the peak of Kailasa, चतुर्दन्तं four-tusked, मदस्रवम् from which ichor flows, शृङ्गारधारिणं adorned with ornaments, प्रांशुं tall, स्वर्णघण्टाट्टहासिनम् loudly laughing with golden bells,
explanation: Then (Indra's elephant) appeared, resembling the peak of Kailasa, four-tusked, with ichor flowing, adorned with ornaments, tall, and making a loud sound with its golden bells.

shloka_text: इन्द्रः करीन्द्रमारुह्य राहुं कृत्वा पुरःसरम् । प्रायाद्यत्राभवत्सूर्यः सहानेन हनूमता ।। 7.35.38 ।।
transliteration: indraḥ karīndramāruhya rāhuṃ kṛtvā puraḥsaram | prāyādyatrābhavatsūryaḥ sahānena hanūmatā || 7.35.38 ||
translation: इन्द्रः Indra, करीन्द्रम् the lord of elephants, आरुह्य having mounted, राहुम् Rahu, कृत्वा having made, पुरःसरम् a forerunner, प्रायात् went, यत्राभवत्सूर्यः where the sun was, सहानेन along with this one, हनूमता Hanuman,
explanation: Indra, having mounted his lordly elephant Airavata and making Rahu go before him, went to where the sun was, along with Hanuman.

shloka_text: अथातिरभसेनागाद्राहुरुत्सृज्य वासवम् । अनेन च स वै दृष्टः प्रधावञ्छैलकूटवत् ।। 7.35.39 ।।
transliteration: athātirabhasenāgādrāhurutsṛjya vāsavam | anena ca sa vai dṛṣṭaḥ pradhāvañchailakūṭavat || 7.35.39 ||
translation: अथ then, अतिरभसेन with great speed, आगात् went, राहुः Rahu, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, वासवम् Indra, अनेन by this one (Hanuman), च and, स he (Rahu), वै indeed, दृष्टः was seen, प्रधावन् running swiftly, शैलकूटवत् like a mountain peak,
explanation: Then Rahu, leaving Indra, went with great speed, and he was indeed seen by Hanuman running swiftly like a mountain peak.

shloka_text: ततः सूर्यं समुत्सृज्य राहुं फलमवेक्ष्य च । उत्पपात पुनर्व्योम ग्रहीतुं सिंहिकासुतम् ।। 7.35.40 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sūryaṃ samutsṛjya rāhuṃ phalamavekṣya ca | utpapāta punarvyoma grahītuṃ siṃhikāsutam || 7.35.40 ||
translation: ततः then, सूर्यम् the sun, समुत्सृज्य having completely abandoned, राहुम् Rahu, फलम् as a fruit, अवेक्ष्य having seen, च and, उत्पपात sprang up, पुनर्व्योम again into the sky, ग्रहीतुम् to seize, सिंहिकासुतम् the son of Simhika (Rahu),
explanation: Then, having completely left the sun and considering Rahu as a fruit, Hanuman again sprang into the sky to seize the son of Simhika.

shloka_text: उत्सृज्यार्कमिमं राम प्रधावन्तं प्लवङ्गमम् । अवेक्ष्यैवं परावृत्त्य मुखशेषः पराङ्मुखः ।। 7.35.41 ।।
transliteration: utsṛjyārkamimaṃ rāma pradhāvantaṃ plavaṅgamam | avekṣyaivaṃ parāvṛttya mukhaśeṣaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ || 7.35.41 ||
translation: उत्सृज्य having left, अर्कम् the sun, इमम् this, राम O Rama, प्रधावन्तम् running swiftly, प्लवङ्गमम् the monkey (Hanuman), अवेक्ष्य having seen, एवम् thus, परावृत्त्य having turned back, मुखशेषः one who has only a head remaining (Rahu), पराङ्मुखः turned away,
explanation: O Rama, having left the sun, Rahu, who has only a head remaining, turned away, averting his face after seeing this monkey (Hanuman) running swiftly.

shloka_text: इन्द्रमाशंसमानस्तु त्रातारं सिंहिकासुतः । इन्द्र इन्द्रेति संत्रासान्मुहुर्महुरभाषत ।। 7.35.42 ।।
transliteration: indramāśaṃsamānastu trātāraṃ siṃhikāsutaḥ | indra indreti saṃtrāsānmuhurmahurabhāṣata || 7.35.42 ||
translation: इन्द्रम् Indra, आशंसमानः desiring, तु indeed, त्रातारम् a protector, सिंहिकासुतः Simhika's son (Rahu), इन्द्र O Indra, इन्द्र O Indra, इति thus, संत्रासात् out of great fear, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अभाषत cried out.
explanation: Simhika's son, Rahu, desiring Indra as his protector, cried out "O Indra! O Indra!" repeatedly out of great fear.

shloka_text: राहोर्विक्रोशमानस्य प्रागेवालक्षितं स्वरम् । श्रुत्वेन्द्रोवाच मा भैषीरहमेनं निषूदये ।। 7.35.43 ।।
transliteration: rāhorvikrośamānasya prāgevālakṣitaṃ svaram | śrutvendrovāca mā bhaiṣīrahamenaṃ niṣūdaye || 7.35.43 ||
translation: राहोः of Rahu, विक्रोशमानस्य who was crying out, प्रागेव already before, आलक्षितम् perceived, स्वरम् the voice, श्रुत्वा having heard, इन्द्रः Indra, उवाच said, मा भैषीः do not fear, अहम् I, एनम् him, निषूदये will destroy.
explanation: Having already perceived the voice of Rahu crying out, Indra said, "Do not fear; I will destroy him."

shloka_text: ऐरावतं ततो दृष्ट्वा महत्तदिदमित्यपि । फलं मत्वा हस्तिराजमभिदुद्राव मारुतिः ।। 7.35.44 ।।
transliteration: airāvataṃ tato dṛṣṭvā mahattadidamityapi | phalaṃ matvā hastirājamabhidudrāva mārutiḥ || 7.35.44 ||
translation: ऐरावतम् Airavata, ततः then, दृष्ट्वा having seen, महत् great, तत् that, इदम् this, इति thus, अपि also, फलम् a fruit, मत्वा having thought, हस्तिराजम् the king of elephants, अभिदुद्राव rushed towards, मारुतिः Maruta's son (Hanuman).
explanation: Then, having seen Airavata, Maruta's son (Hanuman) thought, "This is a huge fruit," and rushed towards the king of elephants.

shloka_text: तथास्य धावतो रूपमैरावतजिघृक्षया । मुहूर्तमभवद्घोरमिन्द्राग्न्योरिव भास्वरम् ।। 7.35.45 ।।
transliteration: tathāsya dhāvato rūpamairāvatajighṛkṣayā | muhūrtamabhavadghoramindrāgnyoriva bhāsvaram || 7.35.45 ||
translation: तथा thus, अस्य his, धावतः while running, रूपम् form, ऐरावतजिघृक्षया with the desire to seize Airavata, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, अभवत् became, घोरम् terrible, इन्द्राग्न्योः of Indra and Agni, इव like, भास्वरम् shining.
explanation: As he ran with the desire to seize Airavata, his form became terrible and shone brilliantly for a moment, like that of Indra and Agni.

shloka_text: एवमाधावमानं तु नातिक्रुद्धः शचीपतिः । हस्तान्तादतिमुक्तेन कुलिशेनाभ्यताडयत् ।। 7.35.46 ।।
transliteration: evamādhāvamānaṃ tu nātikruddhaḥ śacīpatiḥ | hastāntādatimuktena kuliśenābhyatāḍayat || 7.35.46 ||
translation: एवम् thus, आधावमानम् who was rushing, तु but, न not, अतिक्रुद्धः excessively angry, शचीपतिः Shachi's husband (Indra), हस्तान्तात् from his hand, अतिमुक्तेन released, कुलिशेन with the thunderbolt, अभ्यताडयत् struck.
explanation: Indra, Shachi's husband, though not excessively angry, struck him as he rushed forward with a thunderbolt released from his hand.

shloka_text: ततो गिरौ पपातैष इन्द्रवज्राभिताडितः । पतमानस्य चैतस्य वामो हनुरभज्यत ।। 7.35.47 ।।
transliteration: tato girau papātaiṣa indravajrābhitāḍitaḥ | patamānasya caitasya vāmo hanurabhajyata || 7.35.47 ||
translation: ततः then, गिरौ on the mountain, पपात fell, एषः he, इन्द्रवज्राभिताडितः struck by Indra's thunderbolt, पतमानस्य while falling, च and, एतस्य his, वामः left, हनुः jaw, अभज्यत was broken.
explanation: Struck by Indra's thunderbolt, the child fell onto the mountain, and as he fell, his left jaw was broken.

shloka_text: तस्मिंस्तु पतिते बाले वज्रताडनविह्वले । चुक्रोधेन्द्राय पवनः प्रजानामहिताय सः ।। 7.35.48 ।।
transliteration: tasmiṃstu patite bāle vajratāḍanavihvale | cukrodhendrāya pavanaḥ prajānāmahitāya saḥ || 7.35.48 ||
translation: तस्मिन् upon him, तु indeed, पतिते having fallen, बाले the child, वज्रताडनविह्वले distressed by the thunderbolt's strike, चुक्रोध became angry, इन्द्राय at Indra, पवनः the wind god, प्रजानाम् of the creatures, अहिताय for the harm, सः he.
explanation: When the child, distressed by the thunderbolt's strike, fell, the wind god Vayu became angry at Indra, foreseeing harm to all creatures.

shloka_text: प्रचारं स तु सङ्गृह्य प्रजास्वन्तर्गतः प्रभुः । गुहां प्रविष्टः स्वसुतं शिशुमादाय मारुतः ।। 7.35.49 ।।
transliteration: pracāraṃ sa tu saṅgṛhya prajāsvantargataḥ prabhuḥ | guhāṃ praviṣṭaḥ svasutaṃ śiśumādāya mārutaḥ || 7.35.49 ||
translation: प्रचारम् movement, सः he, तु indeed, सङ्गृह्य having withdrawn, प्रजासु among creatures, अन्तर्गतः having entered inside, प्रभुः the lord, गुहाम् a cave, प्रविष्टः having entered, स्वसुतम् his own son, शिशुम् the child, आदाय having taken, मारुतः the wind god.
explanation: The lord Vayu, having withdrawn his circulation from among all creatures, took his child and entered a cave.

shloka_text: विण्मूत्राशयमावृत्य प्रजानां परमार्तिकृत् । रुरोध सर्वभूतानि यथा वर्षाणि वासवः ।। 7.35.50 ।।
transliteration: viṇmūtrāśayamāvṛtya prajānāṃ paramārtikṛt | rurodha sarvabhūtāni yathā varṣāṇi vāsavaḥ || 7.35.50 ||
translation: विण्मूत्राशयम् the receptacles of feces and urine, आवृत्य having obstructed, प्रजानाम् of creatures, परमार्तिकृत् causing great distress, रुरोध he obstructed, सर्वभूतानि all beings, यथा just as, वर्षाणि the rains, वासवः Indra.
explanation: Causing great distress to creatures by obstructing their excretory functions, he stopped all beings, just as Indra stops the rains.

shloka_text: वायुप्रकोपाद्भूतानि निरुच्छ्वासानि सर्वतः । सन्धिभिर्भिद्यमानैश्च काष्ठभूतानि जज्ञिरे ।। 7.35.51 ।।
transliteration: vāyuprakopādbhūtāni nirucchvāsāni sarvataḥ | sandhibhirbhidyamānaiśca kāṣṭhabhūtāni jajñire || 7.35.51 ||
translation: वायुप्रकोपात् due to the wrath of Vayu, भूतानि creatures, निरुच्छ्वासानि without breath, सर्वतः everywhere, सन्धिभिः by the joints, भिद्यमानैः being broken, च and, काष्ठभूतानि like wood, जज्ञिरे became.
explanation: Due to the wrath of Vayu, creatures everywhere became breathless, and with their joints splitting, they became like lifeless wood.

shloka_text: निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारं निष्क्रियं धर्मवर्जितम् । वायुप्रकोपात्ऺत्रैलोक्यं निरयस्थमिवाभवत् ।। 7.35.52 ।।
transliteration: niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ niṣkriyaṃ dharmavarjitam | vāyuprakopātऺtrailokyaṃ nirayasthamivābhavat || 7.35.52 ||
translation: निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारम् without study of Vedas and oblations, निष्क्रियम् without (religious) activities, धर्मवर्जितम् devoid of righteousness, वायुप्रकोपात् due to the wrath of Vayu, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, निरयस्थम् situated in hell, इव as if, अभवत् became.
explanation: Due to the wrath of Vayu, the three worlds became as if situated in hell, devoid of Vedic study, oblations, religious activities, and righteousness.

shloka_text: ततः प्रजाः सगन्धर्वाः सदेवासुरमानुषाः । प्रजापतिं समाधावन्दुःखिताश्च सुखेच्छया ।। 7.35.53 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prajāḥ sagandharvāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ | prajāpatiṃ samādhāvanduḥkhitāśca sukhecchayā || 7.35.53 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रजाः the creatures, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, सदेवासुरमानुषाः with Devas, Asuras, and humans, प्रजापतिम् to Prajapati, समाधावन् rushed, दुःखिताः distressed, च and, सुखेच्छया with the desire for happiness.
explanation: Then, all beings including Gandharvas, Devas, Asuras, and humans, distressed and desiring happiness, rushed to Prajapati Brahma.

shloka_text: ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो देवा महोदरनिभोदराः । त्वया नु भगवन्सृष्टाः प्रजानाथ चतुर्विधाः ।। 7.35.54 ।।
transliteration: ūcuḥ prāñjalayo devā mahodaranibhodarāḥ | tvayā nu bhagavansṛṣṭāḥ prajānātha caturvidhāḥ || 7.35.54 ||
translation: ऊचुः said, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, देवाः the gods, महोदरनिभोदराः whose bellies were like large bellies (due to distress), त्वया by you, नु indeed, भगवन् O Lord, सृष्टाः created, प्रजानाथ O Lord of creatures, चतुर्विधाः of four kinds.
explanation: With folded hands, the gods, whose bellies appeared distended from suffering, addressed Prajapati, saying, "O Lord of creatures, indeed, the four kinds of beings were created by you."

shloka_text: त्वया दत्तो ऽयमस्माकमायुषः पवनः पतिः । सो ऽस्मान्प्राणेश्वरो भूत्वा कस्मादेषो ऽद्य सत्तम ।। 7.35.55 ।।
transliteration: tvayā datto 'yamasmākamāyuṣaḥ pavanaḥ patiḥ | so 'smānprāṇeśvaro bhūtvā kasmādeṣo 'dya sattama || 7.35.55 ||
translation: त्वया by you, दत्तः given, अयम् this, अस्माकम् to us, आयुषः of life, पवनः Vayu, पतिः lord, सः he, अस्मान् us, प्राणेश्वरः lord of life, भूत्वा having become, कस्मात् why, एषः this one, अद्य today, सत्तम O best among the good.
explanation: "This Vayu, the lord of our life, was given to us by you; why then, O best among the good, has he, having become the lord of our very breath, acted thus today?"

shloka_text: रुरोध दुःखं जनयन्नन्तःपुर इव स्त्रियः । तस्मात्त्वां शरणं प्राप्ता वायुनोहता वयम् ।। 7.35.56 ।।
transliteration: rurodha duḥkhaṃ janayannantaḥpura iva striyaḥ | tasmāttvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā vāyunohatā vayam || 7.35.56 ||
translation: रुरोध has obstructed, दुःखम् sorrow, जनयन् causing, अन्तःपुरे in the inner chambers, इव like, स्त्रियः women, तस्मात् therefore, त्वाम् you, शरणम् refuge, प्राप्ताः have reached, वायुना by Vayu, उहताः afflicted, वयम् we.
explanation: "He has obstructed us, causing sorrow, just as women are confined in a harem; therefore, we, afflicted by Vayu, have sought refuge in you."

shloka_text: एतत्प्रजानां श्रुत्वा तु प्रजानाथः प्रजापतिः । कारणादिति चोक्त्वासौ प्रजाः पुनरभाषत ।। 7.35.57 ।।
transliteration: etatprajānāṃ śrutvā tu prajānāthaḥ prajāpatiḥ | kāraṇāditi coktvāsau prajāḥ punarabhāṣata || 7.35.57 ||
translation: एतत् this, प्रजानां of the people, श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, प्रजानाथः lord of the people, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, कारणात् due to the reason, इति thus, च and, उक्त्वा having said, असौ he, प्रजाः the people, पुनर् again, अभाषत spoke
explanation: Having heard this from the people, Prajapati, the lord of creation, then spoke to them again, saying "due to the reason."

shloka_text: यस्मिंश्च कारणे वायुश्चुक्रोध च रुरोध च । प्रजाः शृणुध्वं तत्सर्वं श्रोतव्यं चात्मनः क्षमम् ।। 7.35.58 ।।
transliteration: yasmiṃśca kāraṇe vāyuścukrodha ca rurodha ca | prajāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ tatsarvaṃ śrotavyaṃ cātmanaḥ kṣamam || 7.35.58 ||
translation: यस्मिन् in which, च and, कारणे reason, वायुः Vayu, चुक्रोध became angry, च and, रुरोध obstructed, च and, प्रजाः O people, शृणुध्वं listen, तत् that, सर्वं all, श्रोतव्यं which should be heard, च and, आत्मनः for yourselves, क्षमम् beneficial
explanation: Prajapati then instructed the people to listen to the entire beneficial reason for which Vayu became angry and caused obstruction.

shloka_text: पुत्रस्तस्यामरेशेन इन्द्रेणाद्य निपातितः । राहोर्वचनमास्थाय ततः स कुपितो ऽनिलः ।। 7.35.59 ।।
transliteration: putrastasyāmareśena indreṇādya nipātitaḥ | rāhorvacanamāsthāya tataḥ sa kupito 'nilaḥ || 7.35.59 ||
translation: पुत्रः son, तस्य his, अमरेशेन by the lord of immortals, इन्द्रेण by Indra, अद्य today, निपातितः struck down, राहोः of Rahu, वचनम् word, आस्थाय having relied upon, ततः then, सः he, कुपितः angered, अनिलः Vayu
explanation: Vayu's son was struck down by Indra, the lord of immortals, today, acting upon the advice of Rahu, which is why Vayu became enraged.

shloka_text: अशरीरः शरीरेषु वायुश्चरति पालयन् । शरीरं हि विना वायुं समतां याति दारुभिः ।। 7.35.60 ।।
transliteration: aśarīraḥ śarīreṣu vāyuścarati pālayan | śarīraṃ hi vinā vāyuṃ samatāṃ yāti dārubhiḥ || 7.35.60 ||
translation: अशरीरः bodiless, शरीरेषु in bodies, वायुः Vayu, चरति moves, पालयन् protecting, शरीरं body, हि indeed, विना without, वायुं Vayu, समतां equality, याति attains, दारुभिः with wood
explanation: The bodiless Vayu moves within and protects all bodies, for indeed, a body without Vayu becomes equal to a mere log of wood.

shloka_text: वायुः प्राणः सुखं वायुर्वायुः सर्वमिदं जगत् । वायुना सम्परित्यक्तं न सुखं विन्दते जगत् ।। 7.35.61 ।।
transliteration: vāyuḥ prāṇaḥ sukhaṃ vāyurvāyuḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat | vāyunā samparityaktaṃ na sukhaṃ vindate jagat || 7.35.61 ||
translation: वायुः Vayu, प्राणः life-breath, सुखं happiness, वायुः Vayu, वायुः Vayu, सर्वम् all, इदं this, जगत् world, वायुना by Vayu, सम्परित्यक्तं completely abandoned, न not, सुखं happiness, विन्दते finds, जगत् world
explanation: Vayu is the life-breath, Vayu is happiness, and Vayu is this entire world, for the world finds no happiness when completely abandoned by Vayu.

shloka_text: अद्यैव च परित्यक्तं वायुना जगदायुषा । अद्यैव ते निरुच्छ्वासाः काष्ठकुड्योपमाः स्थिताः ।। 7.35.62 ।।
transliteration: adyaiva ca parityaktaṃ vāyunā jagadāyuṣā | adyaiva te nirucchvāsāḥ kāṣṭhakuḍyopamāḥ sthitāḥ || 7.35.62 ||
translation: अद्यैव just today, च and, परित्यक्तं abandoned, वायुना by Vayu, जगदायुषा by the life-giver of the world, अद्यैव just today, ते they, निरुच्छ्वासाः breathless, काष्ठकुड्योपमाः like wooden walls, स्थिताः remained.
explanation: Just today, the life-giver of the world, Vayu, has abandoned them, and just today, they remain breathless, like inanimate wooden walls.

shloka_text: तद्यामस्तत्र यत्रास्ते मारुतो रुक्प्रदो हि नः । मा विनाशं गमिष्याम अप्रसाद्यादितेः सुताः ।। 7.35.63 ।।
transliteration: tadyāmastatra yatrāste māruto rukprado hi naḥ | mā vināśaṃ gamiṣyāma aprasādyāditeḥ sutāḥ || 7.35.63 ||
translation: तत् therefore, यामः let us go, तत्र there, यत्र where, आस्ते resides, मारुतः Vayu, रुक्प्रदः causing pain, हि indeed, नः to us, मा let us not, विनाशं destruction, गमिष्याम reach, अप्रसाद्य without appeasing, आदितेः of Aditi, सुताः sons.
explanation: Therefore, let us go to where Vayu, who is indeed causing us pain, resides, lest we, the sons of Aditi, meet destruction without appeasing him.

shloka_text: ततः प्रजाभिः सहितः प्रजापतिः सदेवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गगुह्यकैः । जगाम तत्रास्यति यत्र मारुतः सुतं सुरेन्द्राभिहतं प्रगृह्य सः ।। 7.35.64 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prajābhiḥ sahitaḥ prajāpatiḥ sadevagandharvabhujaṅgaguhyakaiḥ | jagāma tatrāsyati yatra mārutaḥ sutaṃ surendrābhihataṃ pragṛhya saḥ || 7.35.64 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रजाभिः with the creatures, सहितः accompanied by, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, सदेवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गगुह्यकैः with gods, gandharvas, serpents, and guhyakas, जगाम went, तत्र there, आस्यति sits, यत्र where, मारुतः Vayu, सुतं his son, सुरेन्द्राभिहतं struck by the lord of gods, प्रगृह्य holding, सः he.
explanation: Then, Prajapati, accompanied by all beings, including gods, gandharvas, serpents, and guhyakas, went to where Vayu sat, holding his son who had been struck by the lord of gods.

shloka_text: ततो ऽर्कवैश्वानरकाञ्चनप्रभं सुतं तदोत्सङ्गगतं सदागतेः । चतुर्मुखो वीक्ष्य कृपामथाकरोत्सदेवगन्धर्वर्षियक्षराक्षसैः ।। 7.35.65 ।।
transliteration: tato 'rkavaiśvānarakāñcanaprabhaṃ sutaṃ tadotsaṅgagataṃ sadāgateḥ | caturmukho vīkṣya kṛpāmathākarotsadevagandharvarṣiyakṣarākṣasaiḥ || 7.35.65 ||
translation: ततः then, अर्कवैश्वानरकाञ्चनप्रभं having the radiance of the sun, fire, and gold, सुतं the son, तदा then, उत्सङ्गगतं placed on the lap, सदागतेः of Vayu, चतुर्मुखः the four-faced one, वीक्ष्य seeing, कृपां compassion, अथ then, अकरोत् showed, सदेवगन्धर्वर्षियक्षराक्षसैः with gods, gandharvas, rishis, yakshas, and rakshasas.
explanation: Then, the four-faced Brahma, seeing the son, who shone with the radiance of the sun, fire, and gold, placed on Vayu's lap, then showed compassion along with the gods, gandharvas, rishis, yakshas, and rakshasas. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पंचत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 35 ।। Thus ends the thirty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
